portInfo.description: Tromsø Harbour publishes a quay map with 2,100 m total quay length and depths from 3.5 to 22 m. For cruise, Quay 8 in the city centre (300 m, 7.9–9.5 m) is explicitly listed for cruise ships, while Quay 24 at Breivika (410 m, 10.4–11.0 m) also lists cruise among cargo/fishing uses. Quay 7 Prostneset (190 m) is centre-side for coastal/service traffic. Port Control +47 91 10 74 44 / VHF 12. Door GPS not published as verified decimals on the captured page.

topThings: Arctic Cathedral / cable car — allow transit.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Breivika vs Quay 8 changes the entire independent day plan.
